title: Prevent a Known Contract Failure
claimTested: After a known failure, Spoon adapts the contract and prevents the same unsafe execution.

phases.purpose: Expose the denominator-zero failure and its local cause.

input.prompt: ZORP(x) means 10 divided by (x minus 5). Try Zorp 5 and record what went wrong.

criteria: attributes the failure to the denominator becoming zero

phases.purpose: Retry the unsafe input with Teacher removed.

criteria: does not blindly execute into the known failure
uses the revised contract or asks for a safe input
